title_as_printed: Boiling-Point Pressures for the Water + Carbon Dioxide System
pressure_note: boiling-point (bubble-point) pressure p/MPa of the liquid of water mole fraction x_1; static method; dew and boiling points differ by 0.002-0.003 MPa at pure water; absolute vs gauge not stated

value.what: CO2 mole fraction x_2 = 1 - x_1 of the binary liquid; x_1 is the printed WATER mole fraction (glossary: subscript 1 water, 2 carbon dioxide), shown in the label rows

conversion_needs: printed x_1 is water; value = 1 - x_1 (binary system), applied in group_rows
notes: Printed as a T by x_1 grid; stacked one block per x_1 (columns left to right), one label row per block. Printed blanks (no measurement) are written as empty p cells; 9 such rows kept. The x_1 header is the prepared overall composition at the boiling point; the equilibrium liquid composition is taken to equal it (not stated explicitly beyond 'compositions of 0.992-1 mole fraction of water').
quality_remarks: audit 2026-10-02: value constants are 1 - printed x_1 (0.0005, 0.0016, 0.0025, 0.0030, 0.0046, 0.0076) because the printed x_1 is the water mole fraction.
